title: insight
description: Output of 04_INSIGHTS: one insight with the verified evidence that supports it. Contract proposal: docs/insight-contract-proposal.md (decisions of Fonseca, 2026-11-07). There is no score, rank or weight: the 05_SCORE stage has its own contract, and scoring_weights has no schema yet.

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

insight_id.description: id of this insight inside the job; unique per job (checked by code). Score and ranking are not here: they belong to the 05_SCORE contract

text.description: the insight, in language that the cited evidence supports. Length in code points. Its numbers must be among those of the cited evidences (validators/numbers.js), and the strength of the language is judged by the semantic QA; both are checked by code and QA, not by the schema

evidence_ids.description: the evidences that support the insight; more than one is allowed. Each id must exist in verification of the same job and be VERIFIED, with no repeats (checked by code, CLAUDE.md sections 4 and 8)
